claim: Amazon ECR stores images in Amazon S3 buckets that Amazon ECR manages; by default it uses server-side encryption with Amazon S3-managed encryption keys, which encrypts your data at rest with an AES-256 encryption algorithm, requires no action on your part and is offered at no additional charge. For more control over encryption, you can use server-side encryption with KMS keys stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

evidence.quote: Amazon ECR stores images in Amazon S3 buckets that Amazon ECR manages. By default, Amazon ECR uses server-side encryption with Amazon S3-managed encryption keys which encrypts your data at rest using an AES-256 encryption algorithm. This does not require any action on your part and is offered at no additional charge.
For more control over the encryption for your Amazon ECR repositories, you can use server-side encryption with KMS keys stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
